verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page explicitly claims organization-wide enforcement of code quality and compliance requirements through standardized, customizable merge checks. This maps directly onto the story, and a second claim about enforcing coding standards and CI/CD policies across teams and repositories reinforces it. However, the evidence is only marketing-level, with no detailed documentation or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how custom merge checks are configured and enforced (check types, blocking behavior, plan tiers), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enforce custom quality and compliance merge checks on pull requests

citations.quote: Enforce code quality policies and compliance requirements across the organization with standardized, customizable merge checks.
enforcing coding standards, CI/CD policies, and change management workflows across all teams and repositories.
